title: Domino Chain Reaction Rigid Body Physics
prompt:
Create a 3D domino chain reaction simulation with rigid body physics, toppling detection, and configurable layouts using Three.js. The entire application must be in a single HTML file.

## Three.js Import
Use this importmap in <head>:
<script type="importmap">
{ "imports": {
    "three": "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/build/three.module.js",
    "three/addons/": "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/examples/jsm/"
} }
</script>
Then in <script type="module">:
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { OrbitControls } from 'three/addons/controls/OrbitControls.js';

## Scene Setup
- Background 0x2a2a3a.
- PerspectiveCamera at (0, 10, 15), looking at (0, 1, 0).
- OrbitControls enabled.
- Ambient light (0x445566, intensity 0.4), directional light (0xffffff, intensity 0.8) at (5, 15, 8), castShadow=true.
- Floor at y=0, size 30x30, 'hardwood2_diffuse.jpg' texture repeat 4x4.
- Enable renderer shadow maps.

## Dominoes
- Each domino: box 0.2 wide, 1.0 tall, 0.5 deep. Material: white (0xeeeeee) with black dot patterns on faces (or just solid colored based on index: alternate 0xeeeeee and 0x222288).
- Default layout: 30 dominoes in a straight line along Z-axis, spacing 0.6 units apart.
- Each domino is a rigid body with: position, rotation (around X axis for forward/backward tilt), angular velocity, linear velocity.
- Mass = 0.5 kg, moment of inertia for thin box ≈ 1/12 * mass * (height² + depth²).

## Rigid Body Physics
- Each domino can rotate around its bottom edge (pivot at base) when toppling.
- Gravity: torque_gravity = mass * g * (height/2) * sin(angle) around pivot.
- **Domino-domino collision**: when a falling domino's top edge contacts the next domino, apply impulse. Detect collision by checking if the top corner of domino i overlaps domino i+1. On contact, transfer angular momentum.
- **Ground collision**: when a domino's angle > 80° (nearly flat), it rests on the ground.
- Restitution between dominoes: 0.3. Friction: 0.5.
- Air damping: angular_vel *= 0.998.

## Chain Reaction
- Press 'T' to topple: apply initial angular velocity 1.0 rad/s to the first domino.
- The chain should propagate: each domino hits the next, transferring enough energy to topple it.
- Track wave speed: distance of furthest toppled domino / elapsed time.

## Layouts
- Press '1': straight line (default 30 dominoes).
- Press '2': curved path (semicircle of 30 dominoes, radius 8).
- Press '3': spiral (40 dominoes in a spiral, 2 turns, radius 3-8).
- Press '4': Y-split (20 dominoes in line, then splits into 2 branches of 10 each at 30° angles).

## Controls
- Press 'T': topple first domino.
- Press '1'-'4': select layout.
- Press 'R': reset all dominoes to standing.
- Press Space: pause/play.
- Slider (id='slider-spacing', range 0.3 to 1.5, step 0.05, default 0.6) for domino spacing.
- Slider (id='slider-count', range 10 to 60, step 5, default 30) for domino count.

## HUD (id='hud')
- Domino count (id='hud-count'): total dominoes
- Toppled (id='hud-toppled'): count of toppled dominoes (angle > 45°)
- Wave speed (id='hud-wave'): toppling wave speed in units/sec, 2 decimals
- Layout (id='hud-layout'): 'Line' / 'Curve' / 'Spiral' / 'Y-Split'
- Spacing (id='hud-spacing'): current spacing, 2 decimals
- Paused (id='hud-paused'): 'Playing' or 'Paused'

## State Management
Expose window.__3D_STATE__ updated every frame:
- `dominoCount`: number
- `toppledCount`: number
- `waveSpeed`: number (rounded to 2 decimals)
- `layout`: string ('Line'|'Curve'|'Spiral'|'Y-Split')
- `spacing`: number
- `isPaused`: boolean
- `frameCount`: number
- `dominoesValid`: boolean (no NaN in positions/rotations)
- `chainComplete`: boolean (all dominoes toppled or wave stopped)
- `maxAngle`: number (max domino tilt angle in degrees, rounded to 1 decimal)

Ensure the animation loop updates __3D_STATE__ every frame before rendering.
physics_constraints: Dominoes topple around bottom edge pivot. Gravity torque = mg*(h/2)*sin(θ). Domino-domino collision transfers angular momentum. Wave must propagate from first to last. Toppled = angle > 45°. Spacing affects whether chain completes. No NaN. Resting on ground when angle > 80°.
